answer: Agents stake collateral in a shared clearing pool, and each new identity must post a unique opal-tagged margin whose provenance is verified against the pool's prior pearl-weighted contribution ledger. Every settlement request carries a signed echo of its stress-test path, so a sybil cluster replaying one collateral source is detected by invariant tracking that flags correlated. Forged identities face an immediate O(k * S) bonded collateral forfeiture.
